plan: Represent everything as plain JSON-shaped dicts with fractions.Fraction quantities; adapt() builds fresh output structures and never mutates inputs, so print_original() just returns authored_text unchanged.
Compute a Fraction scale factor target_yield/recipe_yield and apply it to every ingredient quantity (main, component, and catalog-introduced) before substitution.

Resolve each excluded ingredient with a chain loop: rank catalog candidates by (priority, catalog order), apply the winner's result (name, quantity_factor, unit, preparation), and repeat while the resulting name is still excluded; a per-chain seen-set detects cycles.
Drain additional_ingredients through a worklist so introduced ingredients get the same scaling, exclusion checks, and catalog choices (chained adaptation).

Accumulate choices, warnings, reasons, wording changes, equipment add/remove sets, and yield factors in a context; process optional components in a local context so an unsolvable optional component is dropped with a warning rather than failing the adaptation.

Never stop at the first failure: collect every no-substitution, cycle, and unavailable-equipment reason, then return them sorted and deduplicated with recipe=null; otherwise apply recorded wording changes to all instruction strings, rescale for any yield_factor, sort equipment, and return the complete adapted recipe with sorted warnings and empty reasons.
mechanisms: input-immutable pure functions over freshly built dicts
Fraction yield-scaling factor applied before substitution
chain substitution loop with per-chain seen-set cycle detection
worklist queue for catalog-introduced additional ingredients
local context trial for droppable optional components
exhaustive reason collection with sorted deduplicated reporting
ordered wording-change replay over plain instruction strings
